'''Horsea''' is a character in [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] and [[Pokémon Chamo-Chamo ☆ Pretty ♪]].

Horsea first appeared in ''[[PPPB01|Horsea's Necklace]]'', in which he saved [[Hazel]] from drowning by giving her a scale that allowed her to breathe underwater. Later, Hazel helped him recover a lost necklace that was hidden in a {{p|Cloyster}}. Once retrieved, Horsea gave the necklace as a birthday gift to Lady Marryn, a mermaid he admires.

In ''[[PPPB11|Magikarp Journey]]'', Horsea reunited with Hazel at the beach. He led her, [[Coconut]], and their Pokémon into the ocean to find some {{p|Magikarp}} whiskers. When two {{p|Tentacruel}} attacked the group, Horsea fought back to allow them to escape. After he led everyone into the Magikarp's den, Horsea acted as a translator between the humans and the Magikarp, allowing them to acquire the whiskers.

Horsea reappeared in [[CCP06]] when {{TP|Haruka|Torchic}} and her friends encountered it at the beach. He gave each a scale to let them breathe underwater, then assisted them in finding a {{p|Luvdisc}} after Torchic expressed interest in seeing one.
